facts.activity_file: proving overpressure protection is in service

assets.label: pressure relief devices
assets.service: overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system

control_failures.control_label: setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: fire on PSV-4110 during cleaning and preparation

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was lost time injury, with 1 person injured and 4 days lost.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices on PSV-4110 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically proving overpressure protection is in service. PSV-4110 (pressure relief devices) is in service for overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was never verified as effective. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 24 March 2020 an incident occurred on PSV-4110 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during cleaning and preparation, releasing chemical energy held as hydrocarbon.
